reviews.snippet:
My name is Nitesh Kumar Balwani From Satna A few days ago, I met with a major accident and was admitted for surgery at Unique Super Speciality Hospital Annapurna Indore the care of under Dr. Pramod ji Neema.
From the day I was admitted until my discharge the entire hospital supported me like a younger brother. I especially want to thank Dr Nasim sir from the Radiology Department, Mr. Rahul sir surgery  department, the Head  of the Ayushman unit and Dr Nasim for their immense support and care.
After my surgery , I had completely lost hope about my future, but the Unique family the doctors, nurses, and staff — held my hand and gave me hope and strength to move forward again.
I sincerely express my heartfelt gratitude to everyone for helping me regain confidence in life.
Thank you so much🥰🥰
